helpRole: You play the owner of a shared AI bot. You do not need to know Linux, write code, or set up a server. Choose an answer, check it, and see why it works—or what you missed.
helpRules: There are no lives, timers, or penalties for a wrong answer. Use hints freely. Multi-select missions require exactly the safe choices. In the ordering mission, tap steps in order; tap again to remove one, or use Clear selection to start over.
helpPause: Take a break anytime. Your answers, feedback, and completed missions are saved in this browser when storage is available. Choose Save & pause to return to the welcome screen. Mission trail lets you revisit unlocked lessons.
helpPoints: Each completed mission awards 100 learning points once. Progress is not sent anywhere. Use Reset progress to remove it.
helpDisclaimer: Teaching model, not a security audit: this game simplifies the supplied Hardening a Shared Hermes Agent on Telegram PDF, final edition 28 October 2026. Completing it does not configure, verify, or secure any real system.
helpLimits: Real deployments must be version-checked and tested. The game emphasizes containment, least privilege, and remaining risks rather than treating any design as unbreakable. Never enter real API keys or bot tokens here.
libraryNote: Text versions of every lesson, readable without JavaScript.
resetConfirm: Press again to confirm. This only clears your game progress.
